full_text.title: To all new companies considering…
full_text.text:
To all new companies considering HubSpot: DON'T! Unless you're prepared to pay an outrageous amount.

HubSpot is a good CRM system, but they milk their customers COMPLETELY dry. Nothing respectable about it, and we're leaving too.

To put it in perspective: we already have to pay around €15,000 a year, which is an extremely high amount to begin with. Thanks to this "small change" according to HubSpot, just to be able to create a quote, they're squeezing us by the throat and our annual costs are going up to €25,000. Outrageous.

Recently you have to buy an extra seat just to be able to create quotes????? How?? You can't seriously charge for an extra seat when this is the most important part of the sales process?

The only thing I can imagine is money-grabbing. HubSpot doesn't care about its customers, only about the dollar signs on the bottom line.
